text: In 1921 an archaeologist's assistant reads aloud from the Scroll of Thoth, and the high priest Imhotep, [buried alive for trying to raise his dead lover|origin|the wronged dead return], shuffles out of his tomb. Ten years later he moves through Cairo as the historian Ardath Bey, drawn to Helen Grosvenor, who bears the face of his princess. He [means to kill, mummify and resurrect her|wants|a lover to possess] as his immortal bride, until [a statue of Isis raises its arm|images|dolls, masks and likenesses] and [the scroll catches fire|ending|the evil is destroyed].
